title: Chapter 133
text:
Jade Green Sky and SliceYouUp were shocked.

The damage output of a solo player was higher than the damage output of a small team. The experience gained by a small team had to be shared equally, but Maple Moon had more than 100,000 experience points all by herself. This was terrifying! This meant that she was ahead of all the players, including those from other novice planets!

Maple Moon was stunned by the sudden surprise. Looking at the experience bar on the interface, she could not believe it. During the battle, she had been using the sniper rifle to deal steady damage. She did not expect to be first. She knew herself well and knew that it was all because of Black Phantom's help. This was obviously the benefit of triggering the hidden mission. Maple Moon secretly made up her mind to continue unearthing the hidden mission. Black Phantom, this super thigh, must be held tight.

Han Xiao returned to the car, and Maple Moon obediently returned the sniper rifle.

The players followed them and were surprised to find that Black Phantom had a special interaction with Maple Moon.

Jade Green Sky immediately reacted. "This is the hidden mission!"

"She's so lucky."

Everyone stared at Maple Moon enviously. Maple Moon was not used to being stared at by so many people. Her face turned red, and she quickly hid in the car. Han Xiao did not chase her away. He drove back to Big Horn Village settlement, and the players had no choice but to walk behind him.

While driving, Han Xiao browsed the forum. Suddenly, a new post was pinned to the top. The title was' The combat power of a high-level character '.

He clicked in and saw the battle just now. Some players had uploaded a video of the battle. The Germinal Organization showed their strong combat power. When Seiberi was killing the players, there were very few comments. The viewers were very nervous and felt like they were there. However, in the next moment, Seiberi was killed in one shot. The comments exploded like a geyser. Then, the cannons were activated and directly destroyed the Germinal Organization's troops. The scene was even more shocking.

Dozens of players replied to the post every second. Soon, there were thousands of replies.

"That enemy (Seiberi) is so strong, but he was killed in one shot!"

"Isn't Black Phantom the high-level NPC in Big Horn Village? What's his level?"

"The Mechanic class is so strong. I feel like he has a bright future!"

"F * ck, I was on a planet with a magical background. There was no Mechanic class."

After reading these surprised replies, Han Xiao secretly smiled.

My plan to pretend … Ptui, show off my strength is working.

The effect was very obvious. As soon as they returned to the settlement, the players who had hesitated to change their class could not wait to learn the basic knowledge. Originally, only 20% of the people in Big Horn Village chose to change their class to Mechanic. However, after the video went viral, the players' expectations for the Mechanic class suddenly skyrocketed. Players who were hesitant to change their class immediately changed their class to Mechanic.

One hundred, five hundred, one thousand …

The experience points on the interface were accumulating at an insane rate. Han Xiao had to keep a straight face to prevent himself from laughing out loud. Over the past few days in Big Horn Village, he had obtained two to three million experience points while idling around. It was comparable to the experience points he had accumulated in four to five missions. His efficiency and safety were through the roof! Sure enough, players were the market with the most potential. The NPC template was indeed awesome. Imparting skills was completely free of cost. Only with the interface and the NPC function could such an effect be achieved.

Han Xiao understood the principle of pulling up seedlings to help them grow, so he only imparted the basic skills. These players who were attracted to change their class to Mechanic would be his main customers in the future. After all, his ability was also a Mechanic.

When these players understood the Mechanic class in Version 1.0, they would realize that they had been cheated. There was no use crying and crying. They could either continue playing or start from scratch. In this way, Han Xiao had achieved his goal. As long as these players wanted to quickly improve their combat power, they could only rely on him and buy advanced machinery from him.

Want to become stronger?

How could they not spend money?

Han Xiao took a puff of his cigarette and thought to himself, After a few versions, you will definitely be grateful to me …

Sigh, thinking about this, my conscience does not hurt anymore.

…

On the other side, Jade Green Sky found Maple Moon and asked politely, "Girl, do you have time?"

Maple Moon was confused. Seeing a group of male players with hungry eyes, she took a few steps back in fear and said nervously, "What do you want to do? I'm warning you, this game has a function to prevent sexual harassment! "

The members of Sky Territory did not know whether to laugh or cry. Girl, we are curious about your hidden storyline. We are not interested in you!

Jade Green Sky coughed and said, "I just want to ask how to trigger Black Phantom's hidden storyline. Don't worry, we will pay you accordingly."

Maple Moon shook her head and rejected without hesitation. She liked to dig up hidden storylines, not for profit. Furthermore, she was worried that it would affect Black Phantom's good impression of her.

Jade Green Sky had no choice but to leave. Suddenly, a member said, "We can ask if any other players saw Maple Moon trigger Black Phantom's conversation."

Jade Green Sky's eyes lit up. He nodded in agreement. He really did find something. He found out 'how to trigger the hidden storyline' from a player.

Han Xiao sent away the last few players who came to change their class. Jade Green Sky came over excitedly. Following Maple Moon's conversation, he asked, "Black Phantom, why are you going against the Germinal Organization?"

Oh, a fish has taken the bait.

Han Xiao glanced at him. Hmm, Jade Green Sky. Although he is a president, his potential is not good.

I'll just answer him directly.

"What does it have to do with you?"

Jade Green Sky was confused. Why is this different from Maple Moon's treatment? Was I cheated?

He was not satisfied and changed his lines again and again. Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and did not play along. Jade Green Sky could only give up in the end.

Could it be that it depends on gender?

This thought suddenly appeared in Jade Green Sky's mind. He stared at Han Xiao's salted fish face for a long time, which definitely could not attract the interest of any girl. He suddenly realized that he had seen through the truth.

…

The market potential of the Big Horn Village players had been used up temporarily. It was now the early stage of the game, and the players were still rookies. As they grew and participated in the storyline, there would be more opportunities for him to gain benefits.

Han Xiao had a set of 'business' plans for the players. This was just the beginning. As the players grew, the plan could be gradually implemented.

He was not in a hurry to go to the next novice village. Previously, he had asked Freier in a friendly manner and obtained some information about the evacuation route of the Germinal Organization in Southern Continent. This was a large-scale war, and he estimated that he could obtain a lot of Grade A mission progress. According to his character, he would definitely participate. If he did not do something like this, he would really be a salted fish.

Under the reluctant gazes of the Big Horn Village players, Han Xiao drove away.

Maple Moon watched the car leave and secretly decided that she would contact Black Phantom when she reached level 20.

Just half an hour after Han Xiao left, the panting Mad Blade finally arrived at Big Horn Village. He hurriedly grabbed a player and asked, "Where is Black Phantom?"

"He left long ago."

Mad Blade's face turned pale. He was only half a day late because the West Capital was on lockdown to search for the Germinal Organization spies.

He wanted to cry but had no tears.

…

The battle video on the forum continued to gain popularity. Han Xiao was so far the most powerful high-level character that the players had ever seen. From a few hundred meters away, he could kill a strong enemy with one shot, and he could also control the turrets. These abilities were very desirable to the players. When he appeared, he was like a black phantom, powerful, mysterious, and ghostly. If it was not for the fact that the face simulator looked too salted, he might have attracted a group of female fans.

The player who uploaded the video first was called Mu Chen. He was a lurker, and his posts were always popular. This was the first time that he had experienced the feeling of having thousands of replies. He was reading the replies excitedly.

Ding dong. Suddenly, he received an email from the backend.

Mu Chen was confused. He did not add any friends, so who sent him an email?

"Dear player, your video has been selected as the promotional material for Version 1.0. The reward will be sent to your account within one working day. Please check it — Galaxy Official."
